Package index

Load files

Point sRtr at your SAFs and load them. Start with Getting started; joining files is in Files, keys and joins.

set_srtr_wd()
Set the SRTR working directory
load_srtr_file()
Load an SRTR file and optionally apply labels

Labels and the data dictionary

Factor and variable labels, and the SRTR dictionary they come from. See Releases, the data dictionary and warnings.

apply_srtr_factors()
Apply SRTR factor labels to a data frame
apply_srtr_varlabels()
Apply SRTR variable labels to a data frame
srtr_dictionary()
SRTR data dictionary for a SAF release
dictionary
SRTR Variable Dictionary
dictionary_versions
Stored versions of the SRTR data dictionary
formats
SRTR Format Lookup Table

Missing data

Count and normalize SRTR’s missing-value codes. See Missing data.

srtr_missing_report()
Count the missing-value codes in SRTR data
srtr_normalize_missing()
Normalize missing-value codes in SRTR data
missing_codes
Missing-value codes in the SRTR formats, by type

Risk scores

Add published donor and candidate scores. See Adding risk scores.

add_kdpi()
Add the Kidney Donor Risk Index and Kidney Donor Profile Index
add_epts()
Add the Estimated Post-Transplant Survival score
add_donor_egfr()
Add a donor's estimated glomerular filtration rate
add_lkdpi()
Add the Living Kidney Donor Profile Index
add_pdri()
Add Pancreas Donor Risk Index (PDRI)
add_pvr()
Add pulmonary vascular resistance
optn_mapping_tables
OPTN KDPI and EPTS mapping tables

Outcomes

Death, graft failure, rejection and malignancy, and the time to each. See Rejection and malignancy on follow-up forms and Death, graft failure, and censoring.

srtr_composite_death()
Composite death date (OPTN > SSA > TFL)
add_txf_outcomes()
Add time-to-event follow-up outcomes to a transplant cohort
add_time_to_event_outcomes() experimental
Add death, graft failure, rejection and malignancy outcomes
srtr_time_to_event()
Helper function to add a time-to-event outcome from a date function

Geography

Transplant centers, OPTN regions, OPO service areas and coverage. See Mapping and Coverage gain.

get_hrsa_transplant_centers()
Download HRSA Organ Procurement & Transplantation Center Locations
get_hrsa_optn_regions()
Get OPTN/UNOS Region Boundaries
get_hrsa_opo_service_areas()
Download HRSA OPO Service Area Boundaries
shift_noncontiguous()
Move Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico below the contiguous United States
transplant_centers_sf
U.S. Transplant Centers (sf), EPSG:5070
UNOS_regions_sf
UNOS Regions by State (sf), EPSG:5070
calculate_geography_coverage_gain()
Calculate net geographic coverage gain from adding new coverage areas to an existing coverage base
rank_individual_coverage_gains()
Rank individual candidate areas by marginal coverage gain
